input.quote: a. Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: Section 5(a) imposes an open-ended minimum monthly fee on Client (our party) for both Hosting and Support Services, and Section 6 strips our documentation and dispute rights for those minimums, so the amounts (still blank) would be payable regardless of usage. Although the term is one year with an automatic renewal and Client has a convenience termination right in Section 14, the floor is a take-or-pay element that our playbook resists; the minimal fix is to delete the parenthetical floor and the related carve-outs so we pay only for services actually requested. Fallback (a floor limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Delete the minimum monthly fee floor so we pay only for Hosting and Support Services actually requested.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We removed the minimum monthly fee floor (currently left blank) so that we pay only for the Hosting Services and Support Services we actually request, consistent with our position against take-or-pay commitments. If a floor is essential, we could accept one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and trued up rather than penalised.
